'''Mell Blank''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was an impersonator and extortionist active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
For fraud and usury, he was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] along with 49 other of the most dangerous criminals on [[M'Bardi]] and would be shipped to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While being guarded by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the cruiser was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The cruiser's main reactor was damaged, causing the cells to open and the prisoners who therefore can attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. While the Jedi were trying to hold the prisoners, the crew tried to repair the reactor until they ultimately failed. Blank was one of the first who agreed to help the Jedi in repairing the ship. Moving safely through Republic space, Skywalker thanked Blank and the prisoners for helping and guaranteed that their aid will affect their parole.
